description: This file declares the interface for the MediaKeysCapabilitiesModuleService and its factory within the Rialto media server IPC layer. It defines classes, methods, and external dependencies related to media key system capabilities and client connections.

classes.name: MediaKeysCapabilitiesModuleServiceFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating instances of MediaKeysCapabilitiesModuleService, implementing the IMediaKeysCapabilitiesModuleServiceFactory interface.

classes.name: MediaKeysCapabilitiesModuleService
classes.description: Implementation of the IMediaKeysCapabilitiesModuleService interface, managing media key system capabilities and client connections.

methods.name: MediaKeysCapabilitiesModuleServiceFactory
methods.description: Default constructor for the factory class.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates and returns a shared pointer to a new MediaKeysCapabilitiesModuleService instance.

methods.name: MediaKeysCapabilitiesModuleService
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the service with a reference to ICdmService.

methods.name: supportsKeySystem
methods.description: Checks if a specific key system is supported.

methods.name: getSupportedKeySystemVersion
methods.description: Retrieves the version of a supported key system.
